label: C* in the holding (actualization) sense of being moved: reduction to concurrent actualization
summary: Tested the owner proposal that being moved is having a potential actualized from being caused, as MOTION_3 holding (HeldMotion: in act in a respect while another presently actualizes it there; DEF ea1904bc), an analyst sibling of the First Way (Feser existential reading, attribution deferred), not a reading of ST I q.2 a.3. Verified: respect-general concurrent actualization by another (166dba9d) with the actualizer premise (40fc38ad) gives C* in the holding sense (1dd5be70, result 6cc2aa7c); the respect-general premise follows from its esse instance (f834ee65), accident-inclusive conservation (1a99cebe) and lackable being (6e2176cd) (result 2f538163); the esse instance follows from 76d2cc96 under the present-moment reading dedc431f (result e3de57ec). Direction: one way only. Control part 3 (stick) has C*-holding without either concurrent-actualization premise; part 2 (iron) has the esse instance without accident-inclusive conservation or C*-holding. So C*-holding is a single point of failure on concurrent actualization and adds no cost to the existential-inertia rival; a denier of C*-holding for retained-state movers must deny the respect-general premise, for which existential inertia or accident-exclusive conservation suffices. Independent warrant: experience of received powers supports only the restricted class (instruments, held stones), where a physical present holder is observed; for the hot iron and the projectile no physical present holder is known, so no independent warrant for universal C*-holding was found. Rest of the First Way: the MOTION_1 potency premise fails for MOTION_3 (Control part 4); no-self-motion is not used; the holding regress gives a relative first holder (result 7263cb1a) and, with C*-holding, one whose operative act is unlosable (81523d81); mutual holding is cyclic (result 0b40c6e1: the per se link and the regress exclude it) and two leaning cards are an established statics case (5469677e), so that bundle is inconsistent; pure act and all-respect unheldness are not reached (Control part 6). Also registered the section 8 formal tests: unified derivation 739d177c (CAUSE_2 to CAUSE_1 bridge by 631e014f), extension 9a15e352 to b3573a61 with a1df8f1a, and reciprocity exclusion 0dc12783.
blocker: The holding route is blocked at the holding per se link, which with the regress is inconsistent with mutual holding (two leaning cards); a total-holder or one-series per se link is unformulated. Its relative first holder falls short of all-respect unheldness and pure act. C* in the holding sense has no warrant independent of respect-general concurrent actualization by another for retained-state movers.

current_assessment.scope: C* in the MOTION_3 holding sense (1dd5be70), its derivation from respect-general concurrent actualization by another (166dba9d), and the holding First Way sibling (685933c7 and 6f924bb0 to cf7940a7).
current_assessment.assessment: Shape: concurrent actualization entails C*-holding, not conversely (Control parts 2 and 3). C*-holding is a verified conditional consequence with no warrant of its own for the retained-state class; its standing is that of 76d2cc96 plus accident-inclusive conservation 1a99cebe: dependent, a single point of failure on concurrent actualization, adding no separate cost to the existential-inertia rival. The holding sibling of the absolute First Way is weak: its per se link and regress are inconsistent with mutual holding, and it reaches only a relative first holder with an unlosable operative act, not pure act. The warrant of concurrent actualization against existential inertia is open and assessed on agent/sustaining-vs-inertia, not here.
current_assessment.next_test: Formulate a total-holder (or one-series) holding per se link and test it against the leaning cards; test whether the 2026-11-17 esse-composition route carries a first holder with an unlosable operative act to all-respect unheldness; assess accident-inclusive conservation 1a99cebe (whether sustaining a bearer's being presently holds its retained qualities and states of motion) as the C*-specific bridge.
